name: Witch Doctor: Spirit Link Idol shows its link to the party members every 2 sec (#7564)
contract: Spirit Link Idol 706369 summons creature 522106 for $500992d. Spell.dbc gives 500992 'Spirit Link Idol' as an
APPLY_AURA on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 2000 ms of 500993, with the aura tooltip
'Redistributing nearby allies health every $t1 sec.'; 500993 is a DUMMY on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID
(radius index 13) carrying SpellVisual 120959, the link drawn to each party member. The idol now holds 500992,
so every pulse casts 500993 and the grouped ally receives its SMSG_SPELL_GO from the idol, while the idol AI
still levels both players' health to the shared percentage.

steps.label: The Spirit Link Idol is summoned
DISCRIMINATING: the idol holds its Spirit Link Idol aura 500992
DISCRIMINATING: the ally receives the idol's link pulse 500993
DISCRIMINATING: the link pulses again two seconds later
The pulse still raises the ally to the shared 50%
